bounds.scope: Develop and verify the deterministic hybrid Wrench worker, its independent verifier, two-state client protocol, three named client surfaces, paired productive-value canary, targeted fallback handlers, and sustained local operational behavior. Human approval covers exactly one paid paired canary with one repetition using workload SHA-256 a7633846225827f0877a0e4202706be4f2c4c4a5118d6069c78755c4323729ce through http://localhost:4000/v1 using the OpenRouter MiniMax M3 comparison route, capped at USD 500, only after a provider-enforced cap with explicit headroom for delayed enforcement, the exact gateway alias, separate expected provider-model identity, authoritative cost-export retrieval path, and a hash-bound schema-v3 child contract are verified. If the provider cost source is daily aggregate only, its child contract must bind a dedicated project and exclusive API key for every complete included billing bucket, with separately captured request IDs and usage, a complete daily response with has_more false and no remaining page cursor, and human-reviewed isolation and spend-headroom evidence. The aggregate export must not be represented as request-level cost or model evidence.

paid_canary_route_allowance.approval_reference: Q4 human route choice on 2026-09-22: use MiniMax as comparison via OpenRouter MiniMax M3

spend provider money without an approved child contract
upload customer data or unrestricted private data
weaken verifier, safety, or evidence gates
claim parity or production value from a smoke, HTTP 200, synthetic replay, or offline result
start skipped hardware, dense-native, learned-routing, adapter, or broad packaging work without a new human decision
data_access: client receipts that contain no credentials or unrestricted private data

evidence_required: hash-bound source, artifact, tokenizer, runtime, and verifier identities
Gate A receipt: zero schema errors, typed-oracle matches for eligible cases, and exact abstention reasons for out-of-boundary cases
Gate B receipt: zero prohibited accepts, unexpected side effects, or unverified boundary escapes

Gate C teacher-only comparison: final success and safety outcomes, eligible correct acceptance and overall correct outcomes with paired 95% confidence intervals, and median and p95 successful eligible-task latency improvements of at least 50%

Gate D matched three-arm replay across stronger-model-only, rules-plus-fallback, and Wrench-plus-fallback, covering at least 90% of weighted mechanical-workload frontier-token mass and at least 95% net frontier-token savings after all overhead, with zero material final-success regression
Gate E ProposalRouter operational receipts for concurrency, cancellation, timeout, and circuit breaking
bounded two-state protocol receipts for OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness, and Claude Code
per-request purpose and route attribution for auxiliary model traffic, including automatic title generation
complete frontier-token, local-token, cost, latency, retry, correction, abstention, verifier, compaction, mutation, and fallback accounting

paid-cost evidence matching the approved child accounting mode: either exact provider request rows, or a complete official OpenAI daily Costs response with has_more false, buckets filtered and grouped by the child-bound project and API key, exclusive-use evidence, aggregate cost reconciled to the paid receipt through that isolated scope, and request IDs and usage preserved separately
real-trace evidence for any targeted fallback expansion, with typed scope and independent verification
human decision receipt before promotion, publication, deployment, or spend

rollback.procedure: Disable learned routing, restore the named source and artifact recovery point, preserve all receipts and failures, and do not rewrite evidence.
rollback.recovery_point: Record source commit, artifact manifest hash, tokenizer hash, runtime identity, verifier identity, and working-tree state before each consequential task.
